opening: I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I've noticed a wheezing sound when I breathe out.
I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint.
I ate dark-fleshed fish (like tuna) or Swiss cheese before the reaction started.

opening.text: I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe. I've noticed a wheezing sound when I breathe out. I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint, and my cheeks suddenly turned red. I ate dark-fleshed fish (like tuna) or Swiss cheese before the reaction started.
